title_patterns_that_work: Is [Brand] Legit or a [Category] Scam? (The Real Ratings)
I Checked If [Platform] Is A Scam... (The Truth)
Is [App] Actually Legit? (I Checked The Data)
Can You Actually Trust [Viral Brand]? (The Truth)
title_patterns_to_avoid: Niche developer/obscure tool reviews ('Is Ax-check.com Legit?')
Obscure earning sites or low-recognition crypto platforms ('Gen Z Cash', 'WalkEarn', 'Rainbet')
Vague brand warnings without high curiosity hooks ('Don't Buy Yet')
notes: Content explicitly testing high-profile marketplace scams (Cashify, StubHub) and popular passive earning apps (Sweatcoin, Honeygain) massively outperforms the 30-view channel median. High-performing titles feature sharp polarization ('Legit or a Scam', 'Actually Legit') paired with objective parentheticals like '(I Checked The Data)' or '(The Truth)'. Videos covering obscure utilities, micro-earning apps, or technical vulnerabilities consistently stall in single digits.
